articles.summary: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: EWTX), a leading clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on cardiovascular diseases, today announced that the CIRRUS-HCM abstract was selected for a late-breaking science presentation at the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) Congress, taking place August 28-31 in Munich, Germany. EDG-7500 is a novel, oral, selective cardiac sarcomere modulator designed to slow early contraction and improve cardiac relaxation in symptomatic HCM while preserving systolic function. Late-Breaking Science Presentation: Title: CIRRUS-HCM: 12-Week Evaluation of the Safety and Efficacy of the Novel Cardiac Sarcomere Modulator EDG-7500 in Nonobstructive and Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Presenter: Anjali Tiku Owens, M.D., Associate Professor of Medicine in the Division of Cardiology at the Perelman School of Medicine of the University of Pennsylvania Date: Monday, August 31, 2026, 11:30 – 11:45 am CEST Session: Transforming the heart: novel therapies
articles.title: Edgewise Therapeutics Announces Upcoming Late-Breaking Science Presentation at the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) Congress 2026

articles.summary: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: EWTX), a leading clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on cardiovascular diseases, today reported financial results for the second quarter of 2026 and recent business highlights . "In the second quarter, Edgewise entered into a deal to sell sevasemten and our muscular dystrophy business to Servier. Our post-deal close financial position enhances our ability to advance EDG-7500 and our cardiovascular-focused pipeline toward important clinical and regulatory milestones as an independent company," said Kevin Koch, Ph.D., President and Chief Executive Officer of Edgewise Therapeutics. "With positive Phase 2 CIRRUS-HCM results for EDG-7500 and continued progress with EDG-15400, we are well positioned to advance a differentiated pipeline for patients with serious cardiovascular disease."
